nodes.description: Public bool gating mint execution; set by setPaused, read by mint.
Public uint256 mint price used in the payment requirement of mint.
Public uint256 maximum supply, passed to RandomlyAssigned and reflected in totalSupply().
Public uint256 counter incremented inside the mint loop.
Public string base URI returned by _baseURI() and consumed by tokenURI.
Public uint256 declared as per-transaction mint cap but never enforced in mint.
External payable mint function; validates paused flag, amount and supply, charges cost for non-owners, and mints tokens in a loop.
View function returning the concatenated base URI, token id and .json extension.
onlyOwner function that toggles the paused state variable.
onlyOwner function that updates the base URI string.
onlyOwner payable function that forwards 50% of the balance to a hardcoded address and the remainder to the owner via low-level calls.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, fee payer and ownership check subject.
Low-level .call{value: ...} transfers inside withdraw which forward ether to an arbitrary/hardcoded address before state finalization.
Arithmetic expression cost * _mintAmount used in the mint payment requirement.
Caller-supplied number of tokens to mint; drives the mint loop and the cost multiplication.
Local variable holding the token id returned by nextToken() and passed to _safeMint.
Caller-supplied boolean written into the paused state variable.
Caller-supplied string written into the baseURI state variable.
Caller-supplied token id used for the existence check and URI construction in tokenURI.

edges.reason: msg.sender decides whether the fee requirement applies inside mint and becomes the mint recipient.
msg.sender is compared against owner() by the onlyOwner modifier restricting withdraw.
The paused state variable gates the access to the mint function via require(!paused).
cost is an operand of the cost * _mintAmount multiplication.
_mintAmount is an operand of the cost * _mintAmount multiplication.
The multiplication result is consumed by the payment require inside mint.
withdraw performs externally-visible low-level value calls that can re-enter before completion.
Value transfer in withdraw is triggered by the caller and can invoke the recipient, enabling reentrancy.
The local id returned by nextToken() is passed to _safeMint inside the mint loop.
currentSupply is incremented on each mint iteration.
The _state parameter is written into the paused variable through the owner-only setPaused function.
The _newBaseURI parameter is written into baseURI by the owner-only setBaseURI function.
baseURI is read by tokenURI to build the metadata URI.
The tokenId parameter is used for the existence check and URI concatenation in tokenURI.
maxSupply (via totalSupply and RandomlyAssigned) caps how many tokens mint can create.
maxSupply initializes the RandomlyAssigned base which shapes the minted supply withdrawn against.

normalization_plan.reason: _mintAmount is a parameter of mint; fold it into the mint function node.
local_id only exists inside the mint loop and should be merged into the mint function node.
_state is the parameter of setPaused and should be merged into that function node.
_newBaseURI is the parameter of setBaseURI and should be merged into that function node.
tokenId is the parameter of tokenURI and should be merged into that function node.
